q: What solar records will a GHG verifier ask for?
title: Rooftop solar records for a verifier
short: Expect to show the inverter or generation meter log for the year, the net-metering bill showing import and export, and proof you own the system or the power purchase terms. Only solar you used yourself lowers grid electricity; units exported to the grid are not your consumption.

ul: Monthly generation from the inverter or a separate meter.
Net-metering bills with import, export and net units.
Ownership papers or the solar power purchase agreement.

p: Inverter portals that lost history, and bills showing only net units. Export the log every month and keep it.

senseible: Senseible keeps each figure tied to its invoice, factor and method version, so a verifier can trace any number back to the document it came from.

sources.label: ISO 14064-3, verification of greenhouse gas statements (iso.org)
